ambiguity_note: Shared frames between opposite-label clips do not show that either published label is wrong, and they do not establish a ceiling on classifier accuracy. Two clips cut either side of a behaviour change overlap at the seam and are each correct for their own span. Only clips whose sampled content is largely also published under the other label are quarantined, because those supply contradictory supervision.
caveat: A shared background establishes a shared camera position, not a shared recording. Only frame overlap is treated as certain evidence of one recording. Pairs listed as uncertain are reported, not resolved.
